background: Deutsche Bank is Germany's largest bank, a universal bank with a large investment bank, a corporate bank, German retail banking under the Deutsche and Postbank brands, and the DWS asset manager.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the bank, A+ on average with the weakest at A, two on a positive outlook and one on a stable outlook, after a two-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. The ratings are moving up while the ratios stay on the weak side of EU and Nordic banks: CET1 of 13.9%, leverage of 4.5% and LCR of 140% are all in the bottom quarter, and NSFR of 118% is below the median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Sep 2026.
